spans.s:
ságara, m.
 —1. the atmosphere, Luftmeer;
 —2. Sagara, name of a mythical
prince.

sāgara, m. ocean. [cf. sagara: according
to the legend, a basin hollowed out
by the sons of Sagara, and filled by
Bhagīratha with the water of the Ganges.]

sāgnika, a. having Agni with them, with
Agni. [sa + agni, 1304c: for -ka, see
1222c 2^2 and 1307.]
